name: Singer Solo

clauses.title: Engagement
clauses.body:
The Hirer engages the Artist, and the Artist agrees to perform, on the terms of this Agreement.

The Artist appears as {artist} and performs the services described in Article 3 ({service}).

Where the Artist is supported by other musicians, dancers or crew (the "Personnel"), they are listed in Schedule A. The Artist leads the Personnel and passes on all instructions to them.

clauses.title: Venue, date and times
clauses.body:
The performance takes place at {venue} on {date}, during {time}, or on the dates listed in Schedule B.

The Hirer gives the Artist and Personnel access to the venue at least ninety (90) minutes before the performance for arrival, set-up and sound check, and at least sixty (60) minutes after it for load-out.

Any break, change of running order or extension of time is agreed in writing before the event day, except as set out in the Article on delays, interruptions and overtime.

clauses.title: Scope of services: Solo vocal performance
clauses.body:
The Artist performs live vocals for {service}, in sets totalling the performance time stated in Article 2, with breaks set out in the agreed running order.

The setlist is agreed at least fourteen (14) days before the event. Requests on the day are performed at the discretion of the Artist.

The Artist may perform with backing tracks or with the musicians listed in Schedule A.

A sound check of at least thirty (30) minutes takes place before guests arrive.

clauses.title: Fee, VAT and payment
clauses.body:
The total fee is {total}, which includes UAE Value Added Tax at 5% ({vat}). This Agreement is not a tax invoice. The tax invoice is issued separately through Dealmaker.

The Hirer pays the deposit shown in the booking into Dealmaker escrow when accepting this Agreement, and the remaining balance no later than seven (7) days before the event.

Dealmaker holds all payments and releases them to the Artist after the performance is marked completed. No cash or direct payment to the Artist is required on the event day.

If the balance is not received on time, the Artist may treat the booking as cancelled by the Hirer under Article 7.

clauses.title: Travel, accommodation and meals
clauses.body:
For events in Dubai, local transport of the Artist is included in the fee.

For events in another emirate or outside the UAE, the Hirer provides, or pays for in advance, return transport for the Artist, Personnel and equipment; accommodation of a reasonable standard where the event ends after 23:00 or the journey exceeds two (2) hours; and meals on the event day. These arrangements are confirmed in writing at least seven (7) days before the event.

clauses.title: Confirmation and electronic signature
clauses.body:
The booking is confirmed only when the Hirer has accepted this Agreement on Dealmaker and the deposit has been received in escrow.

The parties agree that acceptance through Dealmaker is a valid electronic signature, and that this Agreement has the same effect as a signed paper document under Federal Decree-Law No. 46 of 2021 on Electronic Transactions and Trust Services.

clauses.title: Cancellation and rescheduling
clauses.body:
The Hirer may cancel by written notice through Dealmaker. The refund of amounts paid is: fourteen (14) days or more before the event, 100%; seven (7) to thirteen (13) days before the event, 50%; fewer than seven (7) days before the event, no refund.

If the Artist cancels for any reason other than Force Majeure, the Hirer receives a full refund of all amounts paid, and Dealmaker may propose a suitable replacement for the Hirer to accept or decline.

The Hirer may move the event once to another date within ninety (90) days at no extra cost, if notice is given at least fourteen (14) days before the original date and the Artist is available.

clauses.title: Obligations of the Hirer
clauses.body:
The Hirer obtains, at its own cost, every permit, licence and approval needed for the event, including any event or entertainment permit issued by the Department of Economy and Tourism in Dubai (DET) or the equivalent authority in another emirate. The Artist provides the passport copies and photographs needed for these applications on request.

The Hirer provides a safe stage, protected from sun and weather where outdoors, safe and adequate power operated by competent persons, and the equipment listed in Schedule C.

If the instruments or equipment of the Artist or Personnel are damaged by faulty power or by the acts of the Hirer, its staff or guests, the Hirer pays for their repair or replacement.

The Hirer provides a private, lockable changing area, drinking water, and secure parking or drop-off near the stage entrance.

clauses.title: Obligations of the Artist
clauses.body:
The Artist arrives on time, performs to a professional standard, and follows the reasonable instructions of the Hirer relating to safety and the running of the event.

The content, language, costume and conduct of the Artist and Personnel respect UAE law, religious and cultural values, the national media content standards and the rules of the venue.

The Artist may replace a member of the Personnel with a competent substitute and informs the Hirer in advance. The Artist may not send a substitute in their own place without the written consent of the Hirer.

clauses.title: Music licensing and voice care
clauses.body:
Licensing of the music for public performance at the venue is the responsibility of the Hirer or the venue.

The Artist may decline to perform outdoors in conditions that put the voice or health of the Artist at risk, including dust storms or temperatures above 40°C without shade, and the parties then agree a new time or an indoor alternative.

clauses.title: Delays, interruptions and overtime
clauses.body:
If the performance is delayed, interrupted or shortened because of the Hirer, the venue or the weather, the full fee remains payable.

The Artist is not obliged to perform beyond the agreed finishing time. Any extension agreed on the day is charged for each started thirty (30) minutes at the pro-rata rate of the fee and is paid through Dealmaker.

clauses.title: Recordings, photographs and intellectual property
clauses.body:
The Hirer may take photographs and short video clips of the performance for its own non-commercial social media, with credit to the Artist.

Any full recording, livestream, broadcast or commercial use of the performance requires the prior written consent of the Artist and may carry an additional fee, in line with the rights of performers under Federal Decree-Law No. 38 of 2021 on Copyright and Neighbouring Rights.

The Artist keeps all rights in their name, image, scripts, music and material. Each party may mention the event in its portfolio after it has taken place.

clauses.title: Force majeure
clauses.body:
Neither party is liable for failure to perform caused by events beyond its reasonable control, including illness or injury of the Artist confirmed by a medical certificate, government orders, official mourning, venue closure, severe weather or travel disruption.

In that case the parties first try to agree a new date within ninety (90) days. If no date is agreed, the amounts held in escrow are refunded to the Hirer, less any costs already incurred with the prior approval of the Hirer.

clauses.title: Liability and indemnity
clauses.body:
Each party is responsible for loss or damage caused by its own negligence or breach of this Agreement.

The Hirer is responsible for the safety of the venue and the behaviour of its guests and staff, and holds the Artist and Personnel harmless from claims arising from them.

Except in cases of death, personal injury or wilful misconduct, the total liability of the Artist under this Agreement does not exceed the total fee.

clauses.title: Personal data and confidentiality
clauses.body:
Each party uses the personal data of the other only to perform this Agreement and to meet legal obligations, in line with Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 on the Protection of Personal Data.

The fee and the terms of this Agreement are confidential and are not shared with third parties other than advisers, competent authorities and Dealmaker.

clauses.title: Future bookings through Dealmaker
clauses.body: For twelve (12) months after the event, the Hirer books the Artist for further events through Dealmaker, so that both parties keep the protection of escrow and of this Agreement.

clauses.title: Governing law and disputes
clauses.body:
This Agreement is governed by the laws of the United Arab Emirates as applied in the Emirate of Dubai, including the Civil Transactions Law issued by Federal Decree-Law No. 25 of 2025.

The parties first try to settle any dispute in good faith within fourteen (14) days, with the help of Dealmaker if either party requests it. If the dispute is not settled, the courts of Dubai have jurisdiction.

clauses.title: General
clauses.body:
This Agreement, its Schedules and the booking details on Dealmaker form the entire agreement between the parties for this event. Changes are valid only if agreed in writing through Dealmaker.

Notices are sent through Dealmaker or to the email addresses stated in this Agreement.

If any provision is found invalid, the rest of this Agreement remains in effect.

clauses.title: Engagement

The Artist appears as {artist} and performs the services described in Article 3 ({service}).

Where the Artist is supported by other musicians, dancers or crew (the "Personnel"), they are listed in Schedule A. The Artist leads the Personnel and passes on all instructions to them.

clauses.title: Venue, date and times
clauses.body:
The engagement takes place at {venue} on {date}, during {time}, or on the dates listed in Schedule B.

The Hirer gives the Artist access to the venue or set in good time for arrival, briefing, technical checks and preparation, as stated in the booking.

Any change of date, time or location is agreed in writing before the engagement day, except as set out in the Article on delays.

clauses.body:
The Artist plays the role stated in the booking in the production {service}, on the shoot days listed in Schedule B, plus the wardrobe fittings, rehearsals and publicity agreed in the booking.

A shoot day is ten (10) hours including a one (1) hour meal break, from call to wrap. Work beyond that is overtime, paid per started hour at the hourly rate plus fifty percent (50%).

The Artist has a rest period of at least eleven (11) hours between wrap and the next call.

Post-production dubbing (ADR) sessions are included up to four (4) hours within thirty (30) days after the last shoot day. Further sessions are paid separately.

clauses.title: Fee, VAT and payment
clauses.body:
The total fee is {total}, which includes UAE Value Added Tax at 5% ({vat}). This Agreement is not a tax invoice. The tax invoice is issued separately through Dealmaker.

The Hirer pays the deposit shown in the booking into Dealmaker escrow when accepting this Agreement, and the remaining balance no later than seven (7) days before the event.

Dealmaker holds all payments and releases them to the Artist after the engagement is marked completed. No cash or direct payment to the Artist is required on the event day.

If the balance is not received on time, the Artist may treat the booking as cancelled by the Hirer under Article 7.

clauses.title: Travel, accommodation and meals
clauses.body:
For events in Dubai, local transport of the Artist is included in the fee.

For events in another emirate or outside the UAE, the Hirer provides, or pays for in advance, return transport for the Artist, Personnel and equipment; accommodation of a reasonable standard where the event ends after 23:00 or the journey exceeds two (2) hours; and meals on the event day. These arrangements are confirmed in writing at least seven (7) days before the event.

clauses.title: Confirmation and electronic signature
clauses.body:
The booking is confirmed only when the Hirer has accepted this Agreement on Dealmaker and the deposit has been received in escrow.

The parties agree that acceptance through Dealmaker is a valid electronic signature, and that this Agreement has the same effect as a signed paper document under Federal Decree-Law No. 46 of 2021 on Electronic Transactions and Trust Services.

clauses.title: Cancellation and rescheduling
clauses.body:
The Hirer may cancel by written notice through Dealmaker. The refund of amounts paid is: fourteen (14) days or more before the event, 100%; seven (7) to thirteen (13) days before the event, 50%; fewer than seven (7) days before the event, no refund.

If the Artist cancels for any reason other than Force Majeure, the Hirer receives a full refund of all amounts paid, and Dealmaker may propose a suitable replacement for the Hirer to accept or decline.

The Hirer may move the event once to another date within ninety (90) days at no extra cost, if notice is given at least fourteen (14) days before the original date and the Artist is available.

clauses.title: Obligations of the Hirer
clauses.body:
The Hirer obtains, at its own cost, every permit, licence and approval needed for the event, including any event or entertainment permit issued by the Department of Economy and Tourism in Dubai (DET) or the equivalent authority in another emirate. The Artist provides the passport copies and photographs needed for these applications on request.

The Hirer provides a safe stage, protected from sun and weather where outdoors, safe and adequate power operated by competent persons, and the equipment listed in Schedule C.

If the instruments or equipment of the Artist or Personnel are damaged by faulty power or by the acts of the Hirer, its staff or guests, the Hirer pays for their repair or replacement.

The Hirer provides a private, lockable changing area, drinking water, and secure parking or drop-off near the stage entrance.

clauses.title: Obligations of the Artist
clauses.body:
The Artist arrives on time, performs to a professional standard, and follows the reasonable instructions of the Hirer relating to safety and the running of the event.

The content, language, costume and conduct of the Artist and Personnel respect UAE law, religious and cultural values, the national media content standards and the rules of the venue.

The Artist may replace a member of the Personnel with a competent substitute and informs the Hirer in advance. The Artist may not send a substitute in their own place without the written consent of the Hirer.

clauses.title: Stunts, nudity and on-set safety
clauses.body:
Stunts are performed by a qualified stunt performer unless the Artist agrees in writing to perform them after a safety briefing.

Any scene with nudity or intimate content is described in writing at least forty-eight (48) hours before it is shot. The Artist may refuse such a scene without losing the fee, and the Hirer makes best efforts to engage an intimacy coordinator.

All content must comply with UAE media content standards, and the Hirer obtains any film or location permits.

clauses.title: Credit and publicity
clauses.body: The Artist is credited in the form agreed in Schedule D. The Artist takes part in the publicity agreed in the booking, and further publicity days are paid separately.

clauses.title: Delays, interruptions and overtime
clauses.body:
If the engagement is delayed, interrupted or shortened because of the Hirer, the venue or the weather, the full fee remains payable.

The Artist is not obliged to perform beyond the agreed finishing time. Any extension agreed on the day is charged for each started thirty (30) minutes at the pro-rata rate of the fee and is paid through Dealmaker.

clauses.title: Rights in the production
clauses.body:
The Hirer owns the recorded production and may use the performance of the Artist in it for the media, territory and period stated in Schedule D. Any use beyond Schedule D, including advertising, merchandise or a new production, needs a new written agreement and fee.

Under Federal Decree-Law No. 38 of 2021, this transfer is valid only because it is in writing and states the right, purpose, duration and territory. The moral rights of the Artist, including the right to be credited and to object to distortion, remain with the Artist.

The Hirer does not create a digital replica, voice clone or AI-generated likeness of the Artist without separate written consent and payment.

The Artist is credited in the form agreed in Schedule D.

clauses.title: Force majeure
clauses.body:
Neither party is liable for failure to perform caused by events beyond its reasonable control, including illness or injury of the Artist confirmed by a medical certificate, government orders, official mourning, venue closure, severe weather or travel disruption.

In that case the parties first try to agree a new date within ninety (90) days. If no date is agreed, the amounts held in escrow are refunded to the Hirer, less any costs already incurred with the prior approval of the Hirer.

clauses.title: Liability and indemnity
clauses.body:
Each party is responsible for loss or damage caused by its own negligence or breach of this Agreement.

The Hirer is responsible for the safety of the venue and the behaviour of its guests and staff, and holds the Artist and Personnel harmless from claims arising from them.

Except in cases of death, personal injury or wilful misconduct, the total liability of the Artist under this Agreement does not exceed the total fee.

clauses.title: Personal data and confidentiality
clauses.body:
Each party uses the personal data of the other only to perform this Agreement and to meet legal obligations, in line with Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 on the Protection of Personal Data.

The fee and the terms of this Agreement are confidential and are not shared with third parties other than advisers, competent authorities and Dealmaker.

The engagement takes place at {venue} on {date}, during {time}, or on the dates listed in Schedule B.

The Hirer gives the Artist access to the venue or set in good time for arrival, briefing, technical checks and preparation, as stated in the booking.

Any change of date, time or location is agreed in writing before the engagement day, except as set out in the Article on delays.

clauses.title: Scope of services: Content creation
clauses.body:
The Artist creates and publishes the content listed in Schedule D for {service}, on the platforms, formats, number of posts and posting window stated there.

The Hirer provides the brief, key messages, products and mandatory hashtags before production. The creative execution is the decision of the Artist within the brief.

clauses.title: Fee, VAT and payment
clauses.body:
The total fee is {total}, which includes UAE Value Added Tax at 5% ({vat}). This Agreement is not a tax invoice. The tax invoice is issued separately through Dealmaker.

The Hirer pays the deposit shown in the booking into Dealmaker escrow when accepting this Agreement, and the remaining balance no later than seven (7) days before the event.

Dealmaker holds all payments and releases them to the Artist after the engagement is marked completed. No cash or direct payment to the Artist is required on the event day.

If the balance is not received on time, the Artist may treat the booking as cancelled by the Hirer under Article 7.

clauses.title: Travel, accommodation and meals
clauses.body:
For events in Dubai, local transport of the Artist is included in the fee.

For events in another emirate or outside the UAE, the Hirer provides, or pays for in advance, return transport for the Artist, Personnel and equipment; accommodation of a reasonable standard where the event ends after 23:00 or the journey exceeds two (2) hours; and meals on the event day. These arrangements are confirmed in writing at least seven (7) days before the event.

clauses.title: Confirmation and electronic signature
clauses.body:
The booking is confirmed only when the Hirer has accepted this Agreement on Dealmaker and the deposit has been received in escrow.

The parties agree that acceptance through Dealmaker is a valid electronic signature, and that this Agreement has the same effect as a signed paper document under Federal Decree-Law No. 46 of 2021 on Electronic Transactions and Trust Services.

clauses.title: Cancellation and rescheduling
clauses.body:
The Hirer may cancel by written notice through Dealmaker. The refund of amounts paid is: fourteen (14) days or more before the event, 100%; seven (7) to thirteen (13) days before the event, 50%; fewer than seven (7) days before the event, no refund.

If the Artist cancels for any reason other than Force Majeure, the Hirer receives a full refund of all amounts paid, and Dealmaker may propose a suitable replacement for the Hirer to accept or decline.

The Hirer may move the event once to another date within ninety (90) days at no extra cost, if notice is given at least fourteen (14) days before the original date and the Artist is available.

clauses.title: Obligations of the Hirer
clauses.body:
The Hirer obtains, at its own cost, every permit, licence and approval needed for the event, including any event or entertainment permit issued by the Department of Economy and Tourism in Dubai (DET) or the equivalent authority in another emirate. The Artist provides the passport copies and photographs needed for these applications on request.

The Hirer provides a safe stage, protected from sun and weather where outdoors, safe and adequate power operated by competent persons, and the equipment listed in Schedule C.

If the instruments or equipment of the Artist or Personnel are damaged by faulty power or by the acts of the Hirer, its staff or guests, the Hirer pays for their repair or replacement.

The Hirer provides a private, lockable changing area, drinking water, and secure parking or drop-off near the stage entrance.

clauses.title: Obligations of the Artist
clauses.body:
The Artist arrives on time, performs to a professional standard, and follows the reasonable instructions of the Hirer relating to safety and the running of the event.

The content, language, costume and conduct of the Artist and Personnel respect UAE law, religious and cultural values, the national media content standards and the rules of the venue.

The Artist may replace a member of the Personnel with a competent substitute and informs the Hirer in advance. The Artist may not send a substitute in their own place without the written consent of the Hirer.

clauses.title: Advertiser permit and disclosure
clauses.body:
The Artist holds a valid advertiser permit issued by the UAE Media Council and states its number in this Agreement. A visiting creator acts through a licensed agency as required.

Every paid, gifted or sponsored post is clearly labelled as advertising in a way that is visible without clicking "more", in line with Federal Decree-Law No. 55 of 2023 and Cabinet Resolution No. 42 of 2025.

Content does not promote alcohol, tobacco or banned products, does not make misleading claims, and respects UAE media content standards.

clauses.title: Approval, reporting and exclusivity
clauses.body:
The Hirer approves or comments on drafts within two (2) working days, with up to two (2) rounds of changes. Silence after that period counts as approval.

The Artist shares screenshots of reach, impressions and engagement within seven (7) days after each post.

The Artist does not post for a directly competing brand from seven (7) days before to seven (7) days after the posts, unless Schedule D states otherwise.

clauses.title: Delays, interruptions and overtime
clauses.body:
If the engagement is delayed, interrupted or shortened because of the Hirer, the venue or the weather, the full fee remains payable.

The Artist is not obliged to perform beyond the agreed finishing time. Any extension agreed on the day is charged for each started thirty (30) minutes at the pro-rata rate of the fee and is paid through Dealmaker.

clauses.title: Content ownership and usage
clauses.body:
The Artist owns the content they create. The Hirer receives a licence to share, repost and embed the content on its own organic channels for the period stated in Schedule D, with credit to the Artist.

Use of the content or the likeness of the Artist in paid advertising, whitelisting, dark posts or any third-party channel requires a separate written licence and fee.

The Artist keeps each agreed post live for at least ninety (90) days unless Schedule D states otherwise, and does not delete or edit it in a way that removes the advertising label.

The Hirer does not create AI-generated likeness, voice or content of the Artist without separate written consent.

clauses.title: Force majeure
clauses.body:
Neither party is liable for failure to perform caused by events beyond its reasonable control, including illness or injury of the Artist confirmed by a medical certificate, government orders, official mourning, venue closure, severe weather or travel disruption.

In that case the parties first try to agree a new date within ninety (90) days. If no date is agreed, the amounts held in escrow are refunded to the Hirer, less any costs already incurred with the prior approval of the Hirer.

clauses.title: Liability and indemnity
clauses.body:
Each party is responsible for loss or damage caused by its own negligence or breach of this Agreement.

The Hirer is responsible for the safety of the venue and the behaviour of its guests and staff, and holds the Artist and Personnel harmless from claims arising from them.

Except in cases of death, personal injury or wilful misconduct, the total liability of the Artist under this Agreement does not exceed the total fee.

clauses.title: Personal data and confidentiality
clauses.body:
Each party uses the personal data of the other only to perform this Agreement and to meet legal obligations, in line with Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 on the Protection of Personal Data.

The fee and the terms of this Agreement are confidential and are not shared with third parties other than advisers, competent authorities and Dealmaker.

clauses.title: Future bookings through Dealmaker
clauses.body: For twelve (12) months after the event, the Hirer books the Artist for further events through Dealmaker, so that both parties keep the protection of escrow and of this Agreement.

clauses.title: Governing law and disputes
clauses.body:
This Agreement is governed by the laws of the United Arab Emirates as applied in the Emirate of Dubai, including the Civil Transactions Law issued by Federal Decree-Law No. 25 of 2025.

The parties first try to settle any dispute in good faith within fourteen (14) days, with the help of Dealmaker if either party requests it. If the dispute is not settled, the courts of Dubai have jurisdiction.

clauses.title: General
clauses.body:
This Agreement, its Schedules and the booking details on Dealmaker form the entire agreement between the parties for this event. Changes are valid only if agreed in writing through Dealmaker.

Notices are sent through Dealmaker or to the email addresses stated in this Agreement.

If any provision is found invalid, the rest of this Agreement remains in effect.
